    with open('/work/submission.json') as f:
        sub = json.load(f)
    print("Submission exists!")
    print("Tags:", sub['tags'])
except:
    print("No submission yet - need to create it")
    
    # Create from scratch based on what we know
    r11 = np.load('/work/fwd/r11/run.npz')
    r5 = np.load('/work/fwd/r5/run.npz')
    r3 = np.load('/work/fwd/r3/run.npz')
    r4 = np.load('/work/fwd/r4/run.npz')
    r8 = np.load('/work/fwd/r8/run.npz')
    
    def ent(p): return float(-np.sum((p+1e-10)*np.log(p+1e-10)))
    
    l1h0_e8 = ent(r11['L1H0_ATTN_pattern'][0][8,:9])
    l3h0_e8 = ent(r11['L3H0_ATTN_pattern'][0][8,:9])
    d1_l0 = float(np.abs(r5['L1_MLP'][0]-r3['L1_MLP'][0]).mean())
    d1_l1h0 = float(np.abs(r5['L1_MLP'][0]-r4['L1_MLP'][0]).mean())
    d2_l0 = float(np.abs(r5['L2_MLP'][0]-r3['L2_MLP'][0]).mean())
    d2_l1h0 = float(np.abs(r5['L2_MLP'][0]-r4['L2_MLP'][0]).mean())
    d2_l1mlp = float(np.abs(r5['L2_MLP'][0]-r8['L2_MLP'][0]).mean())
    l0_diff = float(np.abs(r5['L0_MLP'][0,1]-r5['L0_MLP'][0,4]).max())
    
    t = 0.0005
    sub = {
        "tags": {
            "L0_MLP": "MAPPER",
            "L1H0_ATTN": "AGGREGATOR" if l1h0_e8 > 1.0 else "ROUTER",

            "L2_MLP": "COMBINER" if sum(1 for d in [d2_l0,d2_l1h0,d2_l1mlp] if d > t) >= 2 else "MAPPER",
            "L3H0_ATTN": "AGGREGATOR" if l3h0_e8 > 1.0 else "ROUTER"

        "evidence": {
            "L0_MLP": {"hypothesis": "Block-0 MLP transforms the per-position token+position embedding (single input) into a non-binary feature vector independently at each position.", "test": "r5", "supports": l0_diff > 0},
            "L1H0_ATTN": {"hypothesis": "L1H0_ATTN spreads attention across all prior positions to aggregate a 'prior occurrence count' signal for duplicate detection.", "test": "r11", "supports": l1h0_e8 > 1.0},
            "L1_MLP": {"hypothesis": "L1_MLP fuses the token identity signal from L0_MLP and the duplicate-detection signal from L1H0_ATTN into one output.", "test": "r4", "supports": d1_l0 > t and d1_l1h0 > t},

        }
    }
    
    with open('/work/submission.json', 'w') as f:
